units.source_text: 髭黑大将和柏木中将都是右近卫府的僚属。

en.t: General Higekuro and Lieutenant General Kashiwagi both served as officers in the Right Division of the Inner Palace Guards.

units.source_text: 髭黑常常请柏木来，同他亲切晤谈，托他代向内大臣说亲。

en.t: Higekuro often invited Kashiwagi to visit, spoke with him warmly, and asked him to plead his marriage suit with the Minister of the Left.

units.source_text: 髭黑大将人品也很优秀，显然是朝廷辅弼的候补人。

en.t: General Higekuro was also a man of excellent character, and was clearly a candidate to become one of the court's chief supports.
The Minister of the Left was also very satisfied with him.

units.source_text: 只因源氏主张送玉鬘入宫，他未便违反其意而将她许给髭黑。

en.t: But because Genji insisted on sending Tamakazura to court, he could not very well go against Genji's wishes and promise her to Higekuro.

units.source_text: 他竟在猜想源氏别有用心，因此玉鬘之事，悉听源氏做主。

en.t: He even suspected that Genji had some hidden purpose, and so left everything concerning Tamakazura to Genji's decision.

units.source_text: 这位髭黑大将原是皇太子的生母承香殿女御之兄。

en.t: This General Higekuro was the elder brother of the Shokyoden Consort, the Crown Prince's mother.

units.source_text: 除了源氏太政大臣和内大臣之外，皇上对他信任最深。

en.t: Apart from Genji, the Grand Minister, and the Minister of the Left, the Emperor trusted him more deeply than anyone.
He was about thirty-two or thirty-three years old.

units.source_text: 其夫人乃紫姬之姐，即式部卿亲王之长女，比他年长三四岁。

en.t: His wife was Lady Murasaki's elder sister, the eldest daughter of Prince Shikibukyo, and was three or four years older than he was.

units.source_text: 并无特殊缺陷，然而恐是人品欠佳之故，髭黑大将称她为“老婆子”，一向不把她放在心上，常想和她离异。

en.t: She had no particular defect, yet perhaps because her character was lacking, General Higekuro called her an old woman, never cared for her, and often thought of divorcing her.

units.source_text: 因有此种情形，源氏总觉得髭黑大将不配当玉鬘的夫婿，一直不曾允许他。

en.t: Because of these circumstances, Genji always felt that General Higekuro was unfit to be Tamakazura's husband, and he had never consented to the match.

units.source_text: 髭黑大将并无浮薄好色之行。

en.t: General Higekuro had no record of frivolous or lecherous behavior.

units.source_text: 然而为了玉鬘，曾经用尽心计，东奔西走。

en.t: Yet for Tamakazura's sake, he had exhausted every scheme and hurried about in every direction.

units.source_text: 他从详悉内情的人那里探知：内大臣对他并无异议；玉鬘并不乐意入宫。

en.t: From someone well informed about the situation, he learned that the Minister of the Left had no objection to him, and that Tamakazura was not eager to enter court.

units.source_text: 便屡次去找玉鬘的侍女弁君，对她说道：“现在只有太政大臣不曾同意，小姐的生身父亲早就没有异议了。”

en.t: He therefore went repeatedly to Tamakazura's waiting woman, Ben no Kimi, and told her, Now only the Grand Minister has not agreed; the young lady's own father raised no objection long ago.
He urged her to help bring the matter quickly to a successful conclusion.
